qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Irreplaceable French toll motorway network (APRR/AREA) spanning key north-south European transit corridors. Concession tariffs are contractually indexed to French CPI, ensuring reliable pricing power. 5-year median ROIC of 13.4% and ~71% motorway EBITDA margins prove structural moat strength.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Essential French toll motorway network (APRR/AREA) generating high-margin non-displaceable cash flows, complemented by secularly growing energy infrastructure services. Exceptional employee-ownership culture (>70% staff participation) aligns capital allocation. Non-recourse concession debt covered by 6.4x EBIT/interest and >200% FCF conversion. [5-10Y g: traffic volume 1.0% + toll inflation escalation 2.5% + energy systems mix 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: APRR/AREA concessions provide ~64% of operating profit with ~71% EBITDA margins. 5-year median ROIC is 13.4%, exceeding the 12% hurdle. Owner FCF conversion averaged over 200% from 2022 to 2025 (€2.3B+ Owner FCF in FY2025 vs €1.02B Net Income). EBIT/interest coverage is 6.36x, comfortably surpassing the infrastructure concession threshold.
